posts.title: This Is Hardcore(r)
posts.description: The 90s saw Blur and Oasis at war for the anglophone music market, but the quintessential Britpop band was Pulp . They were there before the beginning , showed kids how to dance , wrapped it up with a killer party, left when the sun rose , and called it a day. Now they spend their days reminiscing .
